en_title: ‘I Got That Completely Wrong’ — Dan Houser Considers Rockstar’s Max Payne 3 a Failure
cn_title: 前编剧认为《马克思佩恩3》失败
subtitle: 「我完全搞错了」
opus_summary: 《马克思佩恩3》编剧Dan Houser承认作品未获应有的成功。游戏虽获媒体好评，商业表现却不佳；他认为玩家怀念原作者的剧本，自己应为失败承担很大一部分责任。

paragraphs.en: Max Payne and its sequel, Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne, are two of the most genre-defining third-person shooters ever made. They propelled Finnish developer Remedy Entertainment into the spotlight as one of the most exciting studios making games. So, it was also going to be a challenge for another developer to pick up the third part of that trilogy. If you have the likes of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption under your belt, though, you might just fancy your chances.
paragraphs.cn: 《马克思佩恩》及其续作《马克思佩恩2：马克思佩恩的陨落》，是有史以来最能定义第三人称射击这一类型的两款游戏。它们让芬兰开发商Remedy Entertainment备受瞩目，成为最令人期待的游戏工作室之一。因此，换一家开发商来接手这部三部曲的第三作，也会是不小的挑战。不过，如果你已经做出了《侠盗猎车手》和《荒野大镖客：救赎》这样的作品，或许就会觉得自己有机会。

paragraphs.en: That’s what former Rockstar VP and writer of Max Payne 3, Dan Houser, thought, and while enjoying the process of making it, he now admits that it didn’t quite hit the mark. Despite being well-received critically, the 2012 game underperformed commercially, and wasn’t a huge hit with players. While Max Payne 3 is a great shooter in its own right, some questioned whether it tonally fit with its heavily noir-influenced predecessors, instead trading in the gloomy, introspective weirdness of Remedy’s New York set games for a more high-octane, colourful, all-action approach.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar前副总裁、《马克思佩恩3》编剧Dan Houser当时就是这么想的。他很享受制作这款游戏的过程，但如今承认，成品并未完全达到预期。这款2012年的游戏虽然获得了媒体好评，商业表现却不佳，也没有在玩家中大受欢迎。单看游戏本身，《马克思佩恩3》是一款出色的射击游戏，但有人质疑，它的基调是否与深受黑色电影影响的前作相符。Remedy的前两作以纽约为背景，氛围阴郁，充满内省和怪诞感；第三作则转向更紧张刺激、色彩鲜明、以动作场面为主的风格。

paragraphs.en: “It was a linear game, so it was a little different from writing an open-world game, a little more structured,” Houser told IGN as part of our IGN30 Icons Series. “I really enjoyed that as an experience. I loved what we did design-wise, the way the game didn't have loads, the way it felt like a 12-hour movie, some of the visual stuff we did with words on screen. I felt we were creating a really cool digital noir experience, and the consensus at the time was that people hated it.
paragraphs.cn: Houser在IGN30 Icons系列采访中告诉IGN：「这是一款线性游戏，所以写起来和开放世界游戏有些不同，结构更明确一些。我真的很享受这段经历。我很喜欢我们在设计上的成果，比如游戏没有加载画面，玩起来像一部12小时的电影，还有我们用屏幕文字做出的一些视觉效果。我觉得我们正在打造一种很酷的数字黑色电影体验，但当时大家普遍认为，玩家讨厌它。」

paragraphs.en: “So I got that completely wrong,” Houser admitted. “I know Sam Lake [creator of Max Payne] well, and he's a very good guy and really talented. I thought we'd done a good job of doing another Max Payne game. Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success. The game is beautifully made, and it wasn't as successful as it should have been. So I would say a large amount of that failure was on me as one of the people making the decisions and also as the writer, when people really missed his writing.”
paragraphs.cn: Houser承认：「所以我完全搞错了。我和Sam Lake［《马克思佩恩》的创作者］很熟，他人很好，也很有才华。我以为我们把另一部《马克思佩恩》游戏做得不错。有些人喜欢，但很多人不喜欢。所以是我们搞错了，或者说，是我搞错了。我失败了。我负责的部分没有成功。游戏制作得很精良，却没有取得应有的成功。因此，我会说，这次失败很大一部分责任在我。我既是参与决策的人之一，也是编剧，而玩家真的很怀念他的剧本。」

paragraphs.en: Max Payne 3 is certainly different in tone to what came before it, but I still hold a lot of love for it. Max Payne 2 remains one of my favourite games to this day due to the storytelling housed in its murky world, but there’s no denying that Rockstar brought something new and flashy to the table almost a decade later when taking the character to Brazil.
paragraphs.cn: 《马克思佩恩3》的基调确实与前作不同，但我依然很喜欢它。《马克思佩恩2》在阴暗世界中讲述的故事，让它至今仍是我最喜欢的游戏之一。不过，不可否认的是，将近十年后，Rockstar把这个角色带到巴西，也带来了新鲜而炫目的东西。

paragraphs.en: That bullet time still feels as sweet as ever to trigger, though, and if that level of polish can be brought over to Remedy’s upcoming remakes of the first two in the trilogy, then they can’t come soon enough. We last heard about the project over a year ago, when the studio revealed that it was in “full production” and that the "collaboration with Rockstar Games remains close and productive."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，触发子弹时间的感觉依然和从前一样爽快。如果Remedy即将推出的三部曲前两作重制版也能达到这样的打磨水准，那真让人迫不及待。我们上一次听到这个项目的消息，还是一年多前。当时工作室透露，项目已进入「全面制作」阶段，并表示「与Rockstar的合作依然紧密且富有成效」。

paragraphs.en: Of course, Rockstar currently has its plate very much full with the imminent launch of GTA 6 on November 19. For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《GTA6》即将于11月19日发售，Rockstar眼下已经忙得不可开交。
